title: Capstone 3: Substitution Cipher Encryptor
subtitle: Cryptography & String Transformation
description: Build secret cipher encoders across 2 interactive stages!

challenges.title: Stage 1: Word Substitution
challenges.description: Encrypt message <hlt>"HELLO"</hlt> character by character using <hlt>cipher_map</hlt>. Print the encrypted string.
challenges.starter_code:
cipher_map = {'H': 'K', 'E': 'H', 'L': 'O', 'O': 'R'}
message = "HELLO"
encrypted = ""
# Stage 1: Character substitution
for ch in message:
    encrypted = encrypted + cipher_map.get(ch, ch)
print(encrypted)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Reusable Encryptor Function
challenges.description: Define <hlt>def encrypt_text(txt):</hlt> returning the substituted ciphertext. Print <hlt>encrypt_text("HELLO")</hlt>.
